_doc: Battle creature actors (M2-CRE-03, docs/kb/art/creatures/pipeline.md). Presentation only: no combat numbers. enemies.json `model` names a row's `scene`; BattleStage turns it into the FighterStandIn spec's `scene` (the M2-UI-07 hook) and merges `stand_in`. CreatureActor reads the rest: which clip an action plays (clip_by_skill, else clip_by_kind by the skill's kind), which clips loop, the KO fade, the boss's phases and breakable parts.
